evidence.excerpt: The official site's Online Order link opens the live Toast menu for Cocineros at 3513 East West Hwy, Hyattsville. Fresh browser inspection found 65 distinct food products and 20 nonalcoholic drinks after repeated Featured and cross-category presentations were consolidated.

The one-page PDF currently linked as Menu was freshly rendered and visually checked. It identifies Cocineros at the exact Hyattsville address and lists 32 current food presentations after option variants are consolidated.

The two-page PDF currently linked as Happy Hour was freshly rendered and visually checked. Its Chicken Nachos and three-taco food offers map to current products; margaritas, mojitos, and beer are alcohol-only and excluded.

The official accepting-orders catering page confirms the exact Hyattsville pickup address and exposes 16 Food Trays products with current descriptions, dietary badges, item-level allergy disclosures, and explicit shared-fryer gluten statements on five products.

The current official site identifies Cocineros in Hyattsville at 3513 East-West Hwy, publishes hours and phone 240-828-5976, and directly links the current main menu PDF, happy-hour PDF, Toast ordering, and catering menu.
This frozen-source Toast route is for Comedor y Pupuseria San Alejo, a separate sibling business/menu, not Cocineros at 3513 East-West Hwy.
This frozen-source Toast route is for San Alejo Restaurant at 7643 New Hampshire Ave, a separate sibling location, not the target Cocineros restaurant.

The frozen baseline cited this former Wix restaurant-menu API. A fresh unauthenticated request no longer returned its historical item payload; current catering scope is taken from the live official catering page instead.
